title: Dungeon carving: brick shells, wall panels, walkable stairs, climbable shafts; DungeonPass rewrite (GenVersion bump)
player_outcome: The dungeon is carved into the world as long brick corridors with dungeon-wall panels. Stairs are walkable and shafts have platforms every 2 m, so you can always climb back. Rooms have pillars, and crossings merge into open junctions instead of walling each other off.
design: Rewrite src/Strata.Core/WorldGen/Structures/DungeonBuilder.cs as the orchestrator: Build(content, layout, DungeonStyle style) → Blueprint. Halls go in DungeonBuilder.Halls.cs and rooms in DungeonBuilder.Rooms.cs. Ops are emitted in phases so crossings merge.
Phase A shells: Fill(interior.Expand(2), brick) for every hall step, room and shaft.
Phase B panels: fill the four side faces of interior.Expand(1) with the room or hall's panel block (brick_wall, slab_wall or tiled_wall of the style colour). Floors and ceilings stay brick.
Phase C carves: Carve every interior (per step for stairs), plus doorways and shaft mouths.
Stair floors: the step cells get ShapeCode Stair rotated uphill; use the same rotation→direction mapping as the builder and CellShape tests.
Shafts: 1-cell brick Platform layers every 4 cells (2 m; the player's jump apex is about 2.4 m and stepHeight 0.55 m).
Rooms wider than 18: 2×2 brick pillars. Rooms taller than 12: a platform gallery at +6 along the long walls.
DungeonStyle.Pick(rng): Brick is blue_brick, green_brick or pink_brick, with the matching Panels[3].

Rewrite src/Strata.Core/WorldGen/Passes/DungeonPass.cs Plan(). Site: the snow-side angle ±0.07 (the jungle is opposite); distance 0.86 × LandRadius, stepping inward while Landness < 0.97. Inward = the dominant axis toward the centre.

Plan() continued: layout = DungeonPlanner.Plan(...); bp = DungeonBuilder.Build(...); add a DungeonFeature : StructureFeature carrying Layout and Style (new overload StructurePlacementPass.AddStructure(plan, feature)).
Plan() landmarks: dungeon_bottom (the vault floor) and dungeon_chest (in front of the first chest spot). dungeon_gate comes in P4-16. Register them in LandmarkIds.
Check that TreasurePass, EcologyZonesPass and DecorationPass skip CellFlags.Structure cells. Add the guard if one is missing, so no cabin chests or plants land inside dungeon walls.

Bump GenVersion.Current by one (with a changelog comment) and re-pin all golden hashes. Add a golden hash for one dungeon chunk (seed 1234 Tiny; chosen from the layout) and include that chunk in the purity test set.
files_modify: src/Strata.Core/WorldGen/Passes/TreasurePass.cs, EcologyZonesPass.cs, DecorationPass.cs — skip structure cells if not already
tests/Strata.Core.Tests/WorldGen/WorldGenTests.cs — re-pin, dungeon golden chunk, purity chunk
tests/Strata.Core.Tests/Gameplay/DungeonTests.cs — use DungeonFeature.Layout instead of magic offsets
tests: DungeonGenerationTests.HallsAreCarvedAndLinedWithProtectedBrick: hall midpoints are air; the neighbouring wall cells carry CellFlags.Structure.
DungeonGenerationTests.StairsAreWalkable: VoxelNavigator path from a stair's top to its bottom.
DungeonGenerationTests.RoomsAreReachableOnFoot: install chunks along the path; A* from the shaft bottom to 3 sampled rooms in Tiny seed 1234.
DungeonGenerationTests.CrossingsStayOpen: at every node the adjoining hall interiors are air.
WorldGenTests purity includes a dungeon chunk; golden hashes re-pinned.
Existing DungeonTests (zones, locks, guardian, keeper) updated and passing.
Smoke dungeon.cmds: 'tp landmark dungeon_bottom', 'wait_until player.frozen == 0 180', 'assert zone.dungeon == 1'.
verification: dotnet test; dotnet run --project tools/Strata.Tools -- worldgen-report --seed=1234 --size=tiny (cross-sections show the halls)
lavapipe: 'tp landmark dungeon_bottom' and screenshots in halls/shafts at medium graphics
risks: Stair shape rotation may be mirrored relative to the mesher. Verify with a screenshot and a navigator test before re-pinning.
Several thousand ops per dungeon lengthens plan time. Measure WorldGenerator construction for Large (target < 150 ms extra).
The terrain phase also bumps GenVersion. Bump from whatever value is current when this lands.
